library(tidyverse)

# Read cleaned datasets
maternal <- read_csv("Maternal_clean.csv") %>%
  rename(maternal_mortality = `deaths/100`)

infant <- read_csv("Infant_clean.csv") %>%
  rename(infant_mortality = `deaths/1`)

life <- read_csv("Life_expectancy_clean.csv") %>%
  rename(life_expectancy = years)

# Merge datasets by country name and region
cia_health_merged <- maternal %>%
  inner_join(infant, by = c("name", "region")) %>%
  inner_join(life, by = c("name", "region"))

# Save merged dataset as CSV
write_csv(cia_health_merged, "CIA_health_merged.csv")

# Exercise 2

# Read merged CIA health dataset
cia_health <- read_csv("CIA_health_merged.csv")

# Aggregate by region using mean
cia_health_by_region <- cia_health %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(
    maternal_mortality = mean(maternal_mortality, na.rm = TRUE),
    infant_mortality   = mean(infant_mortality, na.rm = TRUE),
    life_expectancy    = mean(life_expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Save aggregated dataset as CSV
write_csv(cia_health_by_region, "CIA_health_by_region.csv")

# Exercise 3

# Read merged CIA health dataset (wide format)
cia_health <- read_csv("CIA_health_merged.csv")

# Convert from wide to long format
cia_health_long <- cia_health %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(maternal_mortality, infant_mortality, life_expectancy),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# Save long-format dataset as CSV
write_csv(cia_health_long, "CIA_health_long.csv")
